020import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.obj.QUser;
021import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.operation.Operation;
022import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
023import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
024
025import java.math.BigDecimal;
026import java.util.List;
027
028/**
029 * EconomyTransaction
030 *
031 * @author creatorfromhell
032 * @since 6.2.0.11
033 */
034public interface EconomyTransaction {
035
036  /**
037   * Retrieves the currency associated with this transaction.
038   *
039   * @return a String value representing the currency of the transaction, or null if no currency is
040   * set
041   */
042  @Nullable
043  String currency();
044
045  /**
046   * Sets the currency for the transaction.
047   *
048   * @param currency the currency to be set for the transaction
049   */
050  void currency(final @Nullable String currency);
051
052  /**
053   * Retrieves the amount associated with this transaction.
054   *
055   * @return the BigDecimal value representing the amount of the transaction
056   */
057  @NotNull
058  BigDecimal amount();
059
060  /**
061   * Sets the amount for the transaction.
062   *
063   * @param amount the amount to be set for the transaction
064   */
065  void amount(final @NotNull BigDecimal amount);
066
067  /**
068   * Retrieves the world associated with this transaction.
069   *
070   * @return a String value representing the world of the transaction
071   */
072  @NotNull
073  String world();
074
075  /**
076   * Sets the world associated with this transaction.
077   *
078   * @param world a String value representing the world of the transaction
079   */
080  void world(final @NotNull String world);
081
082  /**
083   * Retrieves the QUser object representing the user associated with this transaction.
084   *
085   * @return the QUser object representing the user associated with this transaction, or null if no
086   * user is set
087   */
088  @Nullable
089  QUser from();
090
091  /**
092   * Sets the QUser representing the user from which the transaction originates.
093   *
094   * @param user the QUser object representing the user initiating the transaction
095   */
096  void from(final @Nullable QUser user);
097
098  /**
099   * Retrieves the QUser object representing the user associated with this transaction.
100   *
101   * @return the QUser object representing the user associated with this transaction, or null if no
102   * user is set
103   */
104  @Nullable
105  QUser to();
106
107  /**
108   * Sets the QUser object representing the user to whom the transaction is targeted.
109   *
110   * @param user the QUser object representing the user receiving the transaction
111   */
112  void to(final @Nullable QUser user);
113
114  /**
115   * Retrieves the QUser object representing the user responsible for applying taxes in this
116   * transaction.
117   *
118   * @return the QUser object representing the taxer, or null if no taxer is set
119   */
120  @Nullable
121  QUser taxer();
122
123  /**
124   * Apply taxes related to a specified user in a transaction.
125   *
126   * @param user the QUser object representing the user to apply taxes to
127   */
128  void taxer(final @Nullable QUser user);
129
130  /**
131   * Calculates and retrieves the tax amount associated with this transaction
132   * based on the defined tax rules or system configuration.
133   *
134   * @return a BigDecimal representing the calculated tax amount for the transaction
135   * @since 6.2.0.11
136   */
137  BigDecimal toTax();
138
139  /**
140   * Sets the tax amount for the current transaction related to the specified user or entity.
141   *
142   * @param tax the tax amount to be set for the transaction, represented as a BigDecimal
143   * @since 6.2.0.11
144   */
145  void toTax(BigDecimal tax);
146
147  /**
148   * Retrieves the tax amount associated with the originator of the transaction.
149   *
150   * @return the tax amount originating from the source of the transaction, represented as a BigDecimal
151   * @since 6.2.0.11
152   */
153  BigDecimal fromTax();
154
155  /**
156   * Sets the tax amount for the current transaction originating from a specific source.
157   *
158   * @param tax the tax amount to be set, represented as a BigDecimal
159   * @since 6.2.0.11
160   */
161  void fromTax(BigDecimal tax);
162
163  /**
164   * Indicates whether the transaction is completable.
165   *
166   * @return true if the transaction can be completed, false otherwise
167   */
168  boolean completable();
169
170  /**
171   * Commits the current transaction, finalizing all operations made.
172   *
173   * @return true if the commit operation is successful, false otherwise
174   */
175  boolean commit();
176
177  /**
178   * Safely commits the transaction, ensuring that all operations are successfully committed.
179   *
180   * @return true if the commit operation is successful, false otherwise
181   */
182  boolean safeCommit();
183
184  /**
185   * Commits the current transaction with the provided callback, finalizing all operations made.
186   *
187   * @param callback the callback to be executed during the commit process
188   *
189   * @return true if the commit operation is successful, false otherwise
190   */
191  boolean commit(@NotNull TransactionCallback callback);
192
193  /**
194   * Rollbacks the list of operations in a transaction, with an option to continue rolling back even
195   * if one operation fails.
196   *
197   * @param continueOnFail a boolean flag indicating whether to continue rolling back if an
198   *                       operation fails
199   *
200   * @return a List of Operation objects representing the rollback status of each operation
201   */
202  List<Operation> rollback(final boolean continueOnFail);
203}
